entities.summary: Fasori Gimnázium, also known as Fasori Evangélikus Gimnázium, official name: Budapest-Fasori Evangélikus Gimnázium, is a famous secondary school in Budapest, Hungary. It is located near the City Park. It is noted, together with Minta and the Piarist gymnasiums, for a number of talented students.
